title: Nominal speed of an electric motor

symbols.definition: Number of magnetic poles created in the stator winding.

applicability: The printed lead-in states that the speed of an electric motor is dependent on the supply frequency and the number of magnetic poles created in the stator winding, and that the formula gives it.
notes: Equation number (5.43) is printed at the right margin of the formula line.

N is not defined in the printed symbol list; only f and P are defined. No definition has been inferred. The following printed sentence gives the worked context 'A normal 4-pole motor runs at a nominal speed of 1500 rpm'.
The printed definition of f ends with the conjunction 'and', which is retained verbatim.
Multiplication is printed with the multiplication sign ×, and the division is printed inline as a slash.
